sub_graphs.title: Gloas: Block and Payload Gossip Protocol
sub_graphs.description: Models the gossip-based propagation of beacon blocks, execution payloads, and execution payload bids across the P2P network

nodes.label: Beacon Block Received via Gossip
nodes.description: A SignedBeaconBlock message has been received on the beacon_block topic but not yet validated

nodes.label: Validate Beacon Block Gossip Message
nodes.description: Validate the beacon block message: check proposer index, signature, slot timing, and that execution payload validations are replaced with bid-based checks

nodes.label: Beacon Block Accepted for Processing
nodes.description: Beacon block passed gossip validation and is forwarded to block processing pipeline

nodes.label: Execution Payload Bid Received
nodes.description: A SignedExecutionPayloadBid has been received on the execution_payload_bid topic

nodes.label: Validate Execution Payload Bid
nodes.description: Validate the bid: verify builder is active via is_active_builder, check payment > 0, match fee_recipient and gas_limit to proposer preferences, verify builder can cover bid via can_builder_cover_bid

nodes.label: Execution Payload Bid Valid
nodes.description: Bid has passed all validation checks and is accepted for consideration

nodes.label: Execution Payload Envelope Received
nodes.description: A SignedExecutionPayloadEnvelope has been received on the execution_payload topic

nodes.label: Validate Execution Payload Envelope
nodes.description: Validate the envelope: verify builder signature, check block root matches known block, verify payload against bid

nodes.label: Execution Payload Envelope Valid
nodes.description: Envelope passed validation and is accepted for execution

edges.label: Peer gossips beacon block on beacon_block topic
Initiate gossip validation of beacon block
Builder submits execution payload bid via gossip

external_entities.name: P2P Network Peer
external_entities.description: Another beacon node connected via the gossipsub protocol

external_entities.name: Execution Payload Builder
external_entities.description: An active builder registered on the beacon chain that submits bids and payloads

sub_graphs.title: Gloas: Proposer Preferences and Bid Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation logic for proposer preferences, builder bids, and the relationship between them

nodes.label: Proposer Preferences Received
nodes.description: A SignedProposerPreferences message received on proposer_preferences topic containing fee_recipient, gas_limit, and slot assignment

nodes.label: Validate Proposer Preferences
nodes.description: Verify the proposer is assigned to the declared slot in the next epoch, validate BLS signature, check preferences are well-formed

nodes.label: Proposer Preferences Stored
nodes.description: Valid proposer preferences are stored and available for bid validation

nodes.label: Check Bid Matches Proposer Preferences
nodes.description: Verify that the bid's fee_recipient and gas_limit match the stored proposer preferences for the target slot

nodes.label: Bid Matches Proposer Preferences
nodes.description: Builder bid parameters are confirmed to match proposer requirements

nodes.label: Check Builder Excess Balance
nodes.description: Verify builder can cover the bid amount via can_builder_cover_bid() check against builder's excess balance

nodes.label: Builder Can Cover Bid
nodes.description: Builder's excess balance is sufficient to cover the execution payment

edges.label: Proposer broadcasts preferences for upcoming slot
Preferences pass validation and are stored
Use stored preferences to validate incoming bid
Bid fee_recipient and gas_limit match preferences
Builder excess balance covers bid amount

external_entities.name: Block Proposer
external_entities.description: Validator assigned to propose a block who broadcasts their fee and gas preferences

sub_graphs.title: Gloas: Request/Response Sync Protocols
sub_graphs.description: Models the request/response protocols for syncing beacon blocks and execution payload envelopes

nodes.label: Node Needs Sync Data
nodes.description: Node determines it is missing beacon blocks or execution payload envelopes and needs to request them

nodes.label: Request Blocks By Range
nodes.description: Send BeaconBlocksByRange v2 request specifying start_slot and count to retrieve gloas.SignedBeaconBlock objects

nodes.label: Request Blocks By Root
nodes.description: Send BeaconBlocksByRoot v2 request with specific block roots to retrieve individual blocks

nodes.label: Request Payload Envelopes By Range
nodes.description: Send ExecutionPayloadEnvelopesByRange v1 request with start_slot and count, limited to MAX_REQUEST_BLOCKS_DENEB

nodes.label: Request Payload Envelopes By Root
nodes.description: Send ExecutionPayloadEnvelopesByRoot v1 request with up to 128 envelope roots for recovery of recent envelopes

nodes.label: Sync Data Received
nodes.description: Requested blocks or payload envelopes have been received from the peer

nodes.label: Validate Sync Response
nodes.description: Validate received blocks/envelopes match the request parameters and pass structural checks

nodes.label: Sync Data Integrated
nodes.description: Validated sync data has been integrated into the local chain database

edges.label: Store validated data in local database

external_entities.name: Sync Peer
external_entities.description: Remote beacon node that responds to req/resp sync protocol requests

ambiguities.text: The validation of execution payload bids requires checking that fee_recipient and gas_limit 'match proposer preferences', but the exact matching semantics (exact equality vs. minimum threshold) are not fully specified.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume exact equality match for both fee_recipient and gas_limit. This is the strictest interpretation.

ambiguities.text: The specification does not clearly define what happens when a proposer has not published preferences but a builder submits a bid for that slot.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume bids for slots without published proposer preferences are rejected. This needs verification.

ambiguities.text: The DataColumnSidecar modifications reference KZG commitments being relocated to block.body.signed_execution_payload_bid.message.blob_kzg_commitments, but the validation path for existing data column sidecar consumers is unclear.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume all data column sidecar validators must be updated to read KZG commitments from the new location in the bid message.

implicit_assumptions.description: The is_active_builder check assumes that the beacon state accurately reflects builder registration status and that builders cannot manipulate their active status.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: A deregistered or malicious builder could submit bids that pass validation, potentially leading to invalid execution payloads being accepted.

implicit_assumptions.description: Proposer preferences are assumed to be published and propagated through gossip before builders need to submit bids for the corresponding slot.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Builders may submit bids that cannot be validated against preferences, causing unnecessary network traffic and potential slot misses.

implicit_assumptions.description: It is assumed that an attacker cannot forge valid BLS signatures for proposer preferences or builder bids.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: An attacker could inject fake proposer preferences to redirect execution payments or submit fraudulent bids.
